'''Serros''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guardian'']], which was [[Assault on the Guardian|attacked]] during the war by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="TCWA" />
